inputs.label: Baa corporate spread
inputs.desc: Moody's Baa yield minus the 10-year Treasury (BAA10Y)

inputs.label: Aaa corporate spread
inputs.desc: Moody's Aaa yield minus the 10-year Treasury (AAA10Y)

inputs.label: Commercial paper spread, nonfinancial
inputs.desc: 3-month AA nonfinancial CP minus the 3-month T-bill

inputs.label: Commercial paper spread, financial
inputs.desc: 3-month AA financial CP minus the 3-month T-bill

inputs.label: Commercial paper outstanding (slower growth = tighter)
inputs.desc: minus the year-on-year % change in CP outstanding (COMPOUT)

inputs.label: Bank business loans (slower growth = tighter)
inputs.desc: minus the year-on-year % change in commercial & industrial loans (TOTCI)

inputs.label: Banks tightening business-loan standards, large & mid firms
inputs.desc: Senior Loan Officer Survey, net % tightening (DRTSCILM)

inputs.label: Banks tightening business-loan standards, small firms
inputs.desc: Senior Loan Officer Survey, net % tightening (DRTSCIS)

inputs.label: Weaker business-loan demand
inputs.desc: minus the Senior Loan Officer Survey net % reporting stronger demand (DRSDCILM)

inputs.label: Nonfinancial corporate debt (slower growth = tighter)
inputs.desc: minus the year-on-year % change in nonfinancial corporate debt securities and loans (Fed Z.1, BCNSDODNS)

inputs.label: Real fed funds rate
inputs.desc: effective fed funds minus core PCE inflation over the past year

inputs.label: Real 30-year mortgage rate
inputs.desc: Freddie Mac 30-year fixed rate minus core PCE inflation over the past year

inputs.label: Mortgage rate spread to the 10-year
inputs.desc: Freddie Mac 30-year fixed rate minus the 10-year Treasury
